program.title: Faithful export
program.goal: The TEI keeps the source text character for character, with review states, passages and producers, for every record.
program.verifiedBy: Invariant tests over all records, tei_all at a pinned release and the profile schema; a fresh agent's hand mutations must all fail.
program.acceptedBy: No acceptance needed; the operator decides the profile questions it raises.

program.title: Complete model
program.goal: One biblStruct per publication, author pages and work hubs as links, and every field exported or excluded with a reason.
program.verifiedBy: The D1 invariants extended; every field exported or a documented exclusion.
program.acceptedBy: Three sample objects: a single publication, a page with several, a work hub.

program.title: SZD page local
program.goal: The bibliography renders as a page of Stefan Zweig Digital in the local harness.
program.verifiedBy: The harness of Stefan Zweig Digital (smoke, golden, RDF structure), screenshots in both languages and an independent interface review.
program.acceptedBy: None locally; Stefan Zweig Digital is accepted on staging only.

program.title: Staging
program.goal: The object o:szd.klawiter is ingested on GAMS Staging and rendered with its stylesheet.
program.verifiedBy: Read-only checks of the staging data streams and the RDF, rendered examples before and after.
program.acceptedBy: The rendered pages on GAMS Staging, in both languages.
program.blockedBy: Needs the operator's VPN and the Cirilo ingest.

program.title: Curation surface
program.goal: A local review route with a queue, checkability first and decisions per value.
program.verifiedBy: Node tests, browser screenshots and an independent review against the reviewer tasks.
program.acceptedBy: The operator tries it on real records.

program.title: Production
program.goal: The reviewed bibliography reaches the production instance.
program.verifiedBy: The D1 to D4 checks on the reviewed data.
program.acceptedBy: The operator instructs the production ingest.
program.blockedBy: Follows the human round of M2 and the identifier scheme.

    <title level="m" resp="#app-rules" ana="#not-reviewed" source="#src-wiki-212-title">Tolstoi, Nietzsche: Studii</title>
    <respStmt>
      <resp>Translated by</resp>

acceptance.question: Should pages classified otherwise, whose entry still describes publications, get them in the export?
acceptance.why: Fixture: the publication layer reads publications from pages that are not edition pages; the export leaves them out.
acceptance.recommendation: Yes: the publication layer reads the entry itself, the page class only sorts pages.

evidence.look: Classified as a work hub, its entry describes five editions.

acceptance.question: Do the sample pages show the publications as Klawiter's entries describe them?
acceptance.why: This is the content check no test can make: whether each marked passage is the value beside it.
acceptance.recommendation: Look at pages 212 and 9001 before answering.

evidence.look: Each value and its marked passage, and the values the language model supplied.
Whether the page splits into the publications Klawiter lists.

acceptance.question: Should an author page become a person with linked contributions, not a publication?
acceptance.why: Author pages list what a person wrote about Zweig, such as forewords in others' volumes.
acceptance.recommendation: Yes: each listed item is a contribution to a publication, and the page is about its author.

evidence.look: A foreword in a 1981 volume, listed under its author.

acceptance.question: Should the local page build on the branch gams-www-split?
acceptance.why: The local harness of Stefan Zweig Digital lives there.
